definitions.gloss: student preparing for entrance exams; exam candidate
definitions.explanation: A student who is studying for and planning to take entrance examinations, typically for high school or university. In Japan, this usually refers to students in their final year before the exam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧{受験生|じゅけんせい}だ。
examples.english: My son is an exam candidate this year.

examples.japanese: {受験生|じゅけんせい}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}している→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: Since I'm preparing for exams, I study late every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{受験生|じゅけんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{応援|おうえん}する→応援する：21988_ouensuru⟧⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あふれる。
examples.english: When winter comes, advertisements encouraging exam students fill the city.

notes:
USAGE:
A culturally significant term in Japan where entrance examinations are a major life event. The exam season peaks in January through March. Families, schools, and businesses all rally around {受験生|じゅけんせい}, with special foods, good-luck charms, and support campaigns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受験生|じゅけんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{応援|おうえん}する→応援する：21988_ouensuru⟧ (to support an exam student)
- {受験生|じゅけんせい}{向|む}け (for exam students)
- {受験生|じゅけんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧ (parents of exam students)
- {受験生|じゅけんせい}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (exam preparation lifestyle)
